I try and let go ..though you do need to let your anger out initially. Those I haven't forgiven, I have let go (no way weighting me down). If they ever feel they need forgiveness just need to ask.

I don't have bowel cancer but close to my bowels so similar issues now have a stoma. Laid up in hospital bed I once said to fellow patient 'I remember when I used to talk about films or theatre.. Not whether I have had bowel movement or farted'
Cannot wait. One of your best roles.
Another 15 minute chill in bed then off to see my friend and my solicitor to be....
Diet is faffy but not impossible and everyone I told was supportive. I have just had it reversed and at moment missing the bag... So def better than unreliable bowel movements.

My ongoing bowel issues post reversal operation not explained fully and when I asked about bowel function following reversal was told would be OK. When I went to pre operation session was too generic for colostomies, ileastomies and reversals, so diet info off.

I have been diagnosed with depression, suspect had/have bi polar self sabotaging I issues too. Better now I recognise this so self awareness key and exercise and counselling better than Meds. Also friends who can put up with you pushing them away at times.
Oh no have put on a pound ....but weight gain put on hold to some extent ....not good time really as January busiest month..but Will keep trying

having slobby day today lying on my sofa. I will try to get energy and strength to do more another day. everything sometimes seems a bit overwhelming and pointless or just cold and jobs to do too dull. But in the way of no-one.

So sorry for you and your heart break. I was always afraid of dying alone ...but now think would like to see my son off on a good day..and go off peacefully on my own. She would have had head full of good memories of you and sadness at thought of losing you too.
#ColdFeet catch up ...made me cry in 3 places....Karen and vicar so wrong ...

NHS staff differ ...some nurses bring you a few supplies at a time ..I have needed adult diapers..as chemo made me and my bowels wonky and sick bowls ...and others ration them out one at a time...first policy saves them time and less potential mess. ..
When you feel your life a bit empty so you organise things and then feel too busy ...but good things to come.
